verses.text: This message came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah. That was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
Jeremiah the prophet spoke it to all the people of Judah and to everyone living in Jerusalem:
For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, until today, the LORD's word has come to me. I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
The LORD has sent all his servants the prophets to you again and again, but you have not listened or paid attention.
They said, "Turn back, each of you, from your evil ways and evil deeds. Then you can live in the land the LORD gave to you and your ancestors forever and ever.
Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them. Do not make me angry with the idols you make with your hands. Then I will not harm you."
"But you did not listen to me," says the LORD. "You made me angry with the idols you made with your hands, and you brought harm on yourselves."
So this is what the LORD of Armies says: "Because you have not listened to my words,

I will send for all the peoples of the north," says the LORD, "and for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I will bring them against this land, against its people, and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and mockery, a ruin forever.
I will take away from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and groom, the sound of millstones, and the light of the lamp.
This whole land will become a horrifying ruin, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
"But when the seventy years are over, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation for their sin," says the LORD. "I will make the land of the Babylonians a ruin forever.
I will bring on that land everything I have said against it, everything written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
Many nations and great kings will make slaves of them too. I will pay them back for what they have done and for the work of their hands."
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take this cup filled with the wine of my anger from my hand. Make all the nations I send you to drink it.
When they drink it, they will stagger and go mad because of the war I will send among them."
So I took the cup from the LORD's hand and made all the nations he sent me to drink it:
Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin, an object of horror, mockery, and cursing, as they are today;
Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, and all his people;
all the foreign people there; all the kings of the land of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines, of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what is left of Ashdod;
Edom, Moab, and the Ammonites;
all the kings of Tyre and Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands across the sea;
Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who cut the corners of their hair;
all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign peoples who live in the desert;
all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and the Medes;
and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after another, all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after them, the king of Sheshach will drink it too.
"Then tell them, 'This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk, and vomit. Fall down and never get up again, because of the war I will send among you.'
If they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: You must drink it!

Look, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that is called by my name. Do you really think you will go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, because I am calling for war against everyone on earth, says the LORD of Armies.'

"So prophesy all these words against them. Tell them: 'The LORD will roar from on high. He will thunder from his holy dwelling. He will roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who stomp grapes, against everyone on earth.
The noise will reach the ends of the earth, because the LORD has a case against the nations. He will judge all people, and he will hand the wicked over to the sword,' says the LORD."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Look, disaster is spreading from nation to nation. A great storm is rising from the farthest parts of the earth."
On that day those killed by the LORD will lie everywhere, from one end of the earth to the other. No one will mourn them, gather them, or bury them. They will lie like manure on the ground.
Cry and wail, you shepherds! Roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock! The time has come for you to be slaughtered and scattered. You will fall and shatter like fine pottery.
The shepherds will have nowhere to run. The leaders of the flock will have no escape.
Listen to the cry of the shepherds and the wailing of the leaders of the flock, because the LORD is destroying their pasture.
The peaceful meadows are silenced because of the LORD's fierce anger.
Like a lion he has left his den. Their land has become a ruin because of the cruel sword and because of his fierce anger.
